desc: Four hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:

Up to 2TB ECC 3DS LRDIMM,
up to DDR4-3200MHz; 8 DIMM slots

2 PCI-E 4.0 x16 (LP) slot;
1 SIOM card support
(flexible networking)
 Note: must bundle with Network card

Integrated IPMI 2.0 + KVM with 
dedicated LAN
• Software Out of Band License key
 (SFT-OOB-LIC) included for
 OOB BIOS management

3 Hot-swap 3.5" SATA3 drive bays
M.2 Interface: 4 SATA/PCI-E 4.0 x4
M.2 Form Factor: 2280, 22110, 2260, 2242
M.2 Key: M-key
